title: DR1 asks the trader to choose a document type from a thirteen-option list; the frontend never asks and guesses the type from the uploaded file's name.

finding.frontend: The add-a-document form asks three questions — Document reference, Date of issue and Upload a file — and carries no document-type control of any kind (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents/template.njk:31-58). The type is guessed after the fact from the file name: the words in the name, extension stripped and separators flattened, are matched against the document-type enum and anything that does not match becomes 'OTHER' (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents/derive-document-type.js:19-23). The controller stamps that guess onto the record it saves (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents/controller.js:108-112). So a certificate saved as scan1.pdf is filed as Other, the trader is never asked, never shown the guess before it is made, and cannot correct it — the added-documents table prints the derived label with no change link beside it.
finding.prototype: DR1 puts a Document type select between Document reference and Date of issue, starting on "Select one" and offering thirteen types: Intra Trade Animal Health Certificate (ITAHC), Veterinary health certificate, Air waybill, Import permit, Letter of authority (Directive 2008/61/EC), Commercial invoice, Sea waybill, Rail waybill, Bill of lading, Catch certificate, Laboratory sampling results for aflatoxin (Reg 2019/1793), Journey log, Other (app/views/upload-documents.html:116-129). It is mandatory: pressing "Save and add another" with the form blank produces four errors, one of which is "Select a document type" linked to the select, and the document is not saved.
finding.difference: Add a mandatory Document type select to the add-a-document form, between Document reference and Date of issue, with DR1's thirteen options and a "Select one" placeholder, and a "Select a document type" error when it is left unset. The obligation the answer belongs to already exists and is already marked mandatory (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/obligations/sections/documents.js:30-35), so the model already expects a real answer here and is currently being fed a guess. Once the question is asked, derive-document-type.js and its test become dead and should be deleted rather than kept as a default — a wrong guess a trader cannot see is worse than no guess. The saved record already carries the field, so nothing downstream changes shape.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding any document-type control rendered on the frontend's upload-documents page, or any step in the frontend journey that shows the trader the derived type and lets them change it.
finding.verification: Ran the falsifier first: searched both frontend rendered DOMs for any select, radio or input carrying a document type and found none — the form is three fields, Document reference, Date of issue and Upload a file, and template.njk:31-58 has no fourth. Then tested the stronger half of the claim, that a mandatory obligation is being satisfied by a filename guess, because if true it is a different finding from "a field is absent". It is true, and both halves check out: accompanyingDocumentType is declared `status: 'mandatory'` (obligations/sections/documents.js:30-35), and its only writer anywhere is controller.js:111, `accompanyingDocumentType: deriveDocumentTypeFromFilename(filename)`, whose fallback is the literal 'OTHER' (derive-document-type.js:22, :25). Nothing asks the trader and nothing shows them the result: the added-documents table's Actions cell holds View file and Remove only (rows.js:27-35, confirmed in the fe-documents-populated DOM), so there is no route to correcting a wrong guess. On the DR1 side the select is captured with its "Select one" placeholder and thirteen options, and dr1-upload-documents-error shows the mandatory claim proved — four errors, one of them "Select a document type" linked to #document-type (routes.js:9124-9130). CORRECT, and if anything understated: the model does not merely lack an answer, it is being handed a fabricated one.

relatedTo.why: the option list the new select needs is the same list whose labels are wrong today
